title: Unnamed Titan 005
summary: An unnamed Titan was encountered by the team of Metz, Simon Judeau, and Eathon Lambert when they were trying to find hidden Titans for the Huntik Foundation. It was joined by Unnamed Titan 004 and Unnamed Titan 006.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* This unnamed Titan originated from the rough concept art of [[Lindorm]]; the artists decided that they wanted Lindorm to belong to [[Lok Lambert]], they changed him into be wolf/dragon instead of an evil "bug monster", and thus the design was reused for the unnamed Titan.
